name: facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/finetuning/data_creation/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.get_single_turn_instance: create a training instance from a specific conversation turn using a tokenizer and chat template
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.get_preference_pairs_from_turn: generate preference pairs from conversation turns with optional agreement or length discouragement scoring
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.get_all_rank_results: load and aggregate rank-sharded JSONL result files from a results directory with optional matrix sorting
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.get_acc_at_k: compute the average accuracy metric across all conversation results in an example dictionary
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.sort_matrix_results: group rank-sharded results by initial prompt and combine into structured conversation result examples

facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.run_correctness_filtering: run correctness filtering on sampling results directories to filter training data by correctness metrics
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.run_preference_pair_generation: run correctness filtering with preference pair generation from conversation turns using a tokenizer
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.run_turn_level_filtering: run correctness filtering with turn-level filtering to extract correct turns with previous context
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.submit_filtering_job: submit a SLURM job to run correctness filtering on sampling results with configurable parameters
facebookresearch_collaborative-reasoner/.run_success_conv_filtering: run correctness filtering keeping only successful conversations with perfect accuracy metrics
